text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before Christmas.
A bud upon a repeat-flowering rose unfurled its petals.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
An understated yet radiant fragrance.
Its strong, resolute petals are truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —This... for me?
choice_data_list: 僭越ながら、お贈りさせていただきたく

text_block_list.text: Breeding roses was originally something I started at Rose Kingdom's suggestion, hoping I might 'take some leisure.'

Captivated by that world, as she strove to cultivate
the national flower of the Rose Kingdom,
it had grown into something that could even be called a passion.

And so, amidst the days spent tending to the roses
in every spare moment—
a single rose bloomed.

A remarkably stalwart, magnificent form.
When I laid eyes upon it, the image of my Liege flashed across my mind.
choice_data_list: （よりよい一輪を、彼女へ贈りたい）

text_block_list.text:
There were still many buds left. If I was to give one,
I wanted it to be the fullest bloom, the single blossom most worthy of her—
and with that in mind, I nurtured it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. Solely to gift it to me,
and for no other reason, then—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You remain as steadfast as ever, I see.
choice_data_list: どれ程に眩いお方であるか、お伝えしたく

text_block_list.text: In the Twinkle Series, days of frustration and conflict were just as plentiful as days of joy.

Along that journey, there were times when she lost her confidence,
and even lost sight of the path she ought to walk.

Having already risen again and taken her first steps toward
a new vision of kingship, she likely had no need for words of encouragement.
Even if that were so—
choice_data_list: これが、我らが王のお姿にございます

text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on her never-ending path as king,
I wanted to convey it to her as many times as necessary.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So this is how I appear through your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Is the 'me' in my own mind...
truly this radiant and full of life?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Could petals ever be so brilliantly crimson,
so full of vigor?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No...
I shall never forget the sight of this solitary bloom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Above all, if I appear to you
as so magnificent a bloom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That is entirely thanks to your dedicated efforts.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Day in and day out, I watered the rose named
Rose Kingdom, bathing her in sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Sweeping away the fear of confronting the curse of thorns,
preparing an environment to hone her strength,
and revealing the true caliber of our king.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thus, I shall never forget the sight of this solitary bloom. Even should it wither away one day—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall engrave this upon my heart.
I thank you for your sincerity.
choice_data_list: もったいなきお言葉です

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............Now then.
In truth, I have a gift for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas Eve.
To show my gratitude for your daily devotion—take this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is black tea that my great-grandmother has long had
custom-ordered from France.
choice_data_list: お心づくしに感謝いたします

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is mine. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Would you allow me to brew you a cup?
Just as you always do for me.

The gentle aroma of black tea and faint notes of rose
softly filled the Trainer's office.
Before long, a steaming cup of tea was gently set before me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I learned how to brew it from my family's butler.
I only hope I look the part, if even a little.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, forgive me.
I am making it rather awkward for you to begin drinking.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again... please, help yourself.
Before it gets cold.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What cruel karma.
Did we walk too much of our path together, I wonder—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Allow me to present this to you—a crimson rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That you have walked alongside me throughout all these days.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And that you will walk beside me
through all the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Above all else—

—The sweet fragrance of roses lingered in the air.
The bouquet entrusted to my hands was surprisingly heavy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For guiding me
to become 'Rose Kingdom'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to present this joy to you along with a bouquet.
...From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
